judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the TDD 'red bar' planning phase and wrote no production code (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `package.json` are completely untouched). It added four failing tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` (rather than the requested `registry.test.ts`), a draft `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, and a `.lore/dod.md` planning file. All four added tests fail against the unmodified codebase, breaking the test suite. Furthermore, most of the required unit tests, the `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` integration test, the `ajv` dependency, and all documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) are entirely missing.
